description: Load the context graph at session start; nudge once to record knowledge after substantial work

hooks.command: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" uv run --quiet --frozen --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -m context_graph.cli hook session-start; else echo "[context-graph] The context graph is unavailable: uv is not installed (or not on PATH). Tell the user to install uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/), restart Claude Code, then run /context-graph:setup."; fi
if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" uv run --quiet --frozen --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -m context_graph.cli hook stop; fi
